sourceManifestCheck.scope: Selected projection hash/length only; other source members and manifest authenticity not independently certified here

nativeStressTolerances.scaleConvention: atol + rtol*max(1,max(abs(current Kirchhoff principal stress))). Native projection uses trial stress scale, unavailable in saved CSV; this independent current-state bound is not enlarged to match failures.

checks.name: saved-gravity-schedule
checks.scope: Saved step endpoints only; CSV cannot prove every unsaved force evaluation

checks.name: initial-unnotched-polygon-quadrature
checks.convention: Every configured regular-lattice center under the unnotched continuous slope; no missing/notched/seeded centers

entire.label: entire saved run including gravity ramp
entire.selectionConvention: Fixed initial cohort/graph; per-state displacement mask; largest component by mass, ties by smallest ID. Candidate IDs are held fixed for every saved velocity in the reported interval. No final-speed selection.

post2s.reason: No actual saved2s state; no interpolation or reference substitution

limitations: A motion candidate requires actual scale1 spatial/plastic-shear review; no automatic scientific PASS.
Fixed grid bottom is not a calibrated Coulomb runout bed; particle-domain overlap/kernel support are not certified by center tests.
Explicit ramp, FLIP ringing, coarse grid/PPC, locking, timestep, domain and basal effects have not been sensitivity-validated.
Downslope projection includes settlement; horizontal displacement/coherence are tested separately.
Native completion, yield colour, maximum speed and toe-front extremum alone do not prove landslide.
Saved-state velocity persistence does not certify unsaved substep behavior; no closed energy balance is inferred.
